beats.say: Four songs: KPop Demon Hunters owns the top ten.
That is like owning four of the top ten spots on a single chart.
It was the first film soundtrack to do this.
The album also won the Oscar for Best Original Song.
Golden took home the Grammy for Best Song Written for Visual Media too.
From Netflix to the Oscars, this soundtrack broke every barrier.
Which of the four top ten songs is your favourite?

sources: Film Facts #2: kpop demon hunters song: the soundtrack history
facts: It became the first film soundtrack on the Billboard Hot 100 to have four of its songs in the top ten simultaneously.
It won the Academy Award for Best Original Song at the 98th Academy Awards.
Golden won Best Song Written for Visual Media at the Grammys.

es.title: KPop Demon Hunters 4 canciones en el top diez 🎵
es.summary: La banda sonora de KPop Demon Hunters hizo historia al colocar cuatro canciones en el top diez del Billboard Hot 100, convirtiéndose en la primera banda sonora de una película en lograrlo.

pt.title: KPop Demon Hunters 4 musicas no top dez 🎵
pt.summary: A trilha sonora de KPop Demon Hunters fez história ao colocar quatro musicas no top dez da Billboard Hot 100, tornando-se a primeira trilha sonora de um filme a conseguir isso.
